operatorProperties.code:
def process(pleasureBayLoad) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = pleasureBayLoad.copy()

    # Determine which Enterococcus column corresponds to Pleasure Bay Beach.
    # Convention in this datasheet: the first Enterococcus column (no suffix) is Pleasure Bay;
    # the suffix .1 / .2 columns are other sites/dedup columns.
    ent_col = 'Enterococcus'

    # Ensure numeric
    df[ent_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[ent_col], errors='coerce')
    df['1-Day Rain'] = pd.to_numeric(df['1-Day Rain'], errors='coerce')

    # Failed swimming standard: Enterococcus > 104 counts per 100 mL
    failed = df[df[ent_col] > 104]

    avg_rain = failed['1-Day Rain'].mean()

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'failedSampleCount': int(failed.shape[0]),
        'avg1DayRainBeforeSampling': float(avg_rain) if pd.notna(avg_rain) else None
    }])

operators.customDisplayName: Filter Pleasure Bay Beach samples to those failing swimming standard (Enterococcus > 104 counts/100mL using column 'Enterococcus'); compute mean of '1-Day Rain' for failed rows; output failedSampleCount and avg1DayRainBeforeSampling
